caption: The drawing features a large, elongated, twisted object positioned diagonally from the bottom right to the upper left within a bordered rectangular frame. This object is rendered in grayscale, with the body showing a twisted or spiral rod design. Both ends of the object terminate in open, rounded hook shapes, with the lower right hook significantly larger than the upper left. Above and to the right of the rod are two separate, similarly shaped forms, each resembling an incomplete circle with a gap at the bottom, also depicted in grayscale with simple outlines. The background is plain and off-white, and some small, scattered brown spots are visible across the page. The artist's name, "MARKEY," is written in small, faint letters in the lower right corner outside the bordered area.
title: Branding Iron
